products.name: Mithila Hand-Painted Madhubani Tussar Silk Saree
products.tagline: Handcrafted folk motifs painted with natural botanical pigments on unbleached Bhagalpur silk

pickup.note: Meet master artisan Sunita Devi & view community loom

hyperlocal.note: Delivered by LokKart runner in sealed bamboo cylinder

specs.colors: Vegetable Madder, River Indigo, Lamp Black & Haldi Yellow
specs.technique: Freehand Bamboo Nib (Kachi Pen) painting over 21 days

products.description: An authentic GI-tagged masterpiece straight from the Mithila folk painting hearth. Each stroke depicts sacred peacocks symbolizing romance, blooming lotuses embodying purity, and the holy Tree of Life. Painted with organic mineral pigments ground on river stones.

products.name: GI-Tagged Organic Roasted Phool Makhana (500g)
products.tagline: Sun-dried lotus seeds slowly hand-roasted in clay pans by Mithila wetland farmers

pickup.note: Direct collection from community packaging depot

hyperlocal.note: Freshly roasted batch dispatched via local runner

specs.material: Grade 6+ Jumbo Popped Lotus Seeds (Euryale ferox)
specs.processing: Hand-puffed over wood embers, zero palm oil
specs.weight: 500g sealed kraft bag with airlock zipper

products.description: Mithila produces over 85% of India's world-renowned Makhana. Procured directly from traditional Mallah wetland harvesting families, ensuring fair price equity and unmatched crunchy sweetness.

products.name: Traditional Black Clay Terracotta Floral Vase
products.tagline: Deep charcoal luster obtained from sealed straw-smoke reduction kilns

pickup.note: Pickup at pottery kiln yard, inspect safe packing

hyperlocal.note: Handled with fragile air-pocket shock padding

global.note: Wooden crated packaging for long-distance transit

specs.finish: Burnished with river pebbles, no chemical glaze

products.description: Famous GI craft of Gorakhpur artisans. The distinctive natural black sheen is achieved without artificial paint: wet smoke from mustard husks impregnates the red clay during kiln sealing.

products.name: Hand-Carved Sheesham Wood Spice Box with Brass Inlay
products.tagline: Nine internal chambers with hand-fitted brass latch for whole gourmet spices

specs.material: Seasoned Indian Rosewood (Sheesham) & Pure Brass wire
specs.chambers: 9 spice compartments with glass view top lid

products.description: Every groove of floral Tarkashi inlay is etched with chisel and delicate brass wire hammered flush by Saharanpur artisans whose families have practiced for over two centuries.

products.name: Pure Banarasi Katan Silk Zari Brocade Saree
products.tagline: Woven on manual jacquard pit looms with pure silver electroplated zari

hyperlocal.note: Direct dispatch in ceremonial velvet pouch

specs.pallu: Elaborate Shikargah forest hunting motifs in gold brocade
specs.length: 6.5 Metres with certified Silk Mark tag

products.description: An heirloom bridal drape embodying the soul of sacred Varanasi. Takes up to 28 days of dual-weaver synchronization on a heritage pit loom.

products.name: Channapatna Lacquer Wooden Rocking Horse Toy
products.tagline: Glossy child-safe natural vegetable dye lacquer turned on wood lathe

specs.dyes: Turmeric yellow, Indigo blue, Kumkum crimson lacquer

products.description: Known worldwide as 'Gombegala Ooru' (Toy Town), Channapatna craftsmen turn sustainable soft wood on manual lathes, buffing friction-heated natural shellac and vegetable extracts.

products.name: Hand-Painted Madhubani Peacock Tussar Silk Dupatta
products.tagline: Exquisite dancing peacock & lotus border on golden raw silk

specs.technique: Fine bamboo pen work with natural dyes

products.description: Versatile styling accessory showcasing delicate lines and tribal fish/peacock symbols. A statement piece celebrating sustainable Indian haute craft.

products.name: Pure Ahimsa Tussar Silk Handloom Fabric (3 Metres)
products.tagline: Peace silk harvested without harming the silkworm cocoon, Bhagalpur spun

specs.texture: Rich slubbed raw matte texture with golden sheen

products.description: Ethically spun peace silk. The silkworm pierces the cocoon and flies freely as a moth before the silk is spun by cooperative weavers.

products.name: Bhagalpuri Handwoven Pure Khadi Linen Zari Saree
products.tagline: Authentic Bhagalpur handloom woven with natural flax linen and antique copper zari temple border

specs.material: 60% Organic Linen + 40% Bhagalpur Ahimsa Tussar Silk
specs.border: Hand-interlocked temple motifs with antique copper zari

products.description: Bhagalpur's celebrated confluence of organic breathable linen and wild tussar silk. Hand-loomed with precision, offering an airy drape, natural luster, and comfortable luxury for all Indian seasons.

products.name: Bhagalpuri Handwoven Katia Silk Shawl / Stole
products.tagline: Heavy textured hand-spun Katia silk shawl with subtle fringes and tribal selvedge

specs.feel: Raw rustic texture with natural warmth and thermal regulating fibers

products.description: Katia silk is spun from the outer rough layers of the tussar cocoon, yielding a tactile, rich earthen fabric cherished by connoisseurs for its authentic hand-spun weight and drape.

products.name: Old Delhi Heritage Zardozi Hand-Embroidered Velvet Clutch
products.tagline: Intricate metallic dabka and golden wire zardozi work handcrafted by Shahjahanabad master karigars

specs.material: Pure Silk Velvet, Copper-Gilt Gold Dabka & Semi-Precious Beads
specs.dimensions: 8 Inches x 5 Inches with detachable antique chain

products.description: Royal Mughal Zardozi embroidery practiced continuously for three centuries in the historic lanes of Old Delhi. Hand-stretched on traditional wooden karchob frames.

products.name: Barun Handwoven Desi Khadi Cotton Stole & Gamcha
products.tagline: 100% organic indigenous cotton spun on Ambar Charkha along the Son River basin
products.description: Hand-spun natural cotton using non-electric pit looms. Unmatched softness and breathability rooted in traditional Magadh riverbank agriculture.

products.name: Manpur Patwatoli Handloom Cotton Gamcha & Bedsheet Set
products.tagline: Woven on Manchester-of-Bihar traditional shuttle looms by Patwatoli weaver families
products.description: Famous craft of Manpur Patwatoli, known as the 'Manchester of Bihar'. Sturdy, breathable handloom cotton woven by generational artisan households.
